Claim 1: A wearable electrocardiography monitor, comprising:
a flexible backing having an adhesive surface, a mid-section, a distal end,
and a proximal end, wherein the mid-section is narrower than the distal end and the
proximal end;a monitor recorder configured to output feedback to a patient, the monitor
recorder comprising:a plurality of electrical contacts;
a wireless transceiver;
a temperature sensor;
a feedback button disposed on a top surface of the monitor recorder,
wherein the feedback button is configured to receive feedback from the
patient; andelectronic circuitry comprising an electrocardiographic front end
circuit to sense electrocardiographic signals via a distal electrocardiography electrode and a proximal electrocardiography electrode;
a receptacle fixed to the flexible backing, wherein the receptacle is
configured to receive the monitor recorder, the receptacle comprising:a plurality of electrical pads configured to interface with the
plurality of electrical contacts;a battery compartment configured to house a battery, the battery
compartment including a spring, wherein a pair of electrical pads of the plurality of the electrical pads electrically interface the battery to the monitor recorder; anda seal circumferentially surrounding the plurality of electrical pads;
a flexible circuit comprising:
an inline resistor;
a proximal circuit trace, wherein the proximal circuit trace
electrically couples the proximal electrocardiography electrode to a first electrical pad of the plurality of electrical pads; anda distal circuit trace, wherein the distal circuit trace electrically
couples the distal electrocardiography electrode to a second electrical pad of the plurality of electrical pads.
Claim 2: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the flexible backing includes an SpO2 sensor.
Claim 3: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the distal end and the proximal end are asymmetric about the mid-section.
Claim 4: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the feedback button is circular and waterproof.
Claim 5: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the feedback button is positioned on a side of the wearable
electrocardiography monitor opposite to a further side on which the plurality of electrical contacts are positioned.
Claim 6: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the battery is vertically aligned with the wireless transceiver.
Claim 7: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the adhesive surface is only provided on the distal end and the proximal
end.
Claim 8: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of Claim 1,
wherein the electrocardiographic signals are transmitted to at least one of a server, a client computer, or a mobile device via the wireless transceiver after the
electrocardiographic signals are converted to a different format.
Claim 9: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the distal end and the proximal end are rounded on respective outer edges.
Claim 10: A wearable electrocardiography monitor, comprising:
a backing having a distal end and a proximal end, wherein the backing is
configured to adhere to skin of a patient via an adhesive surface on the distal end and the proximal end;a receptacle fixed to the backing, wherein the receptacle is configured to
receive the monitor recorder, the monitor recorder comprising:a temperature sensor;
a plurality of electrical contacts extending from the monitor
recorder, wherein, when the monitor recorder engages the receptacle, the plurality of electrical contacts contact a plurality of electrical pads;electronic circuitry comprising an electrocardiographic front end
circuit to sense electrocardiographic signals via a distal electrocardiography electrode and a proximal electrocardiography electrode; anda feedback button disposed on a top surface of the monitor recorder,
wherein the feedback button is configured to receive feedback from the
patient;
a battery compartment configured to house a battery, wherein the battery
compartment is formed on a bottom surface of the receptacle, wherein the battery compartment includes a spring, and wherein a pair of electrical pads of the plurality of the electrical pads electrically interface the battery to the monitor recorder; anda flexible circuit comprising:
an inline resistor;
a proximal circuit trace, wherein the proximal circuit trace
electrically couples the distal electrocardiography electrode to a first electrical pad of the plurality of electrical pads; anda distal circuit trace, wherein the distal circuit trace electrically
couples the distal electrocardiography electrode to a second electrical pad of the plurality of electrical pads.
Claim 11: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the wireless transceiver is configured to communicate with an external
device via Wi-Fi, mobile phone communication standards, or Bluetooth.
Claim 12: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the flexible backing includes an SpO2 sensor.
Claim 13: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the distal end and the proximal end are asymmetric about the mid-section.
Claim 14: The wearable electrocardiography monitor of : The wearable electrocardiography monitor of
wherein the battery is vertically aligned with the wireless transceiver;
wherein the battery is disposed between the monitor recorder and the skin
of the patient;wherein the wireless transceiver is configured to communicate at least a
portion of the electrocardiographic signals; andwherein the backing includes a mid-section having a first edge
parallel to a second edge.
